svg.title: Advisor: let the model consult a second model
svg.desc: Advisor gives the executor model an advisor tool. On the local path, calling advisor(prompt) runs a separate agent with the advisor model, and its answer comes back as the tool result. When the executor and advisor are both on Anthropic, or both on OpenRouter, the provider's native AdvisorTool runs the consultation inside the model request instead.
